description: eth2-monitor watches a set of Ethereum staking validators for missed/delayed attestations, missed/empty/vanilla proposals, and beacon-API health. Top→bottom = Global → Cluster → Validator.

panels.title: Current Epoch
panels.description: Most recently processed epoch (the just-ended one from the SSE head stream). One epoch ≈ 6.4 minutes, so this tile should tick up about every 6 minutes. If it stops climbing, the monitor or beacon endpoint is stuck.

panels.title: Distance p99
panels.description: 99th-percentile canonical inclusion distance in shifted slots (0 = optimal, included one slot after attesting). Per cluster, over the dashboard's selected time range. Tracks how far each cluster's worst-case inclusion is from optimal.

panels.title: API Errors
panels.description: Beacon API non-2xx response share over the dashboard's selected time range, excluding 4xx on /eth/v2/beacon/blocks/{block_id} (those 404s are the canonical missed-proposal signal the monitor relies on, not an infrastructure problem). Infrastructure health, not a validator metric.

panels.title: Success %
panels.description: Fleet-wide attestation success share over the dashboard's selected time range: sum(served) / (sum(served) + sum(missed)).

panels.title: Missed %
panels.description: Fleet-wide attestation miss share over the dashboard's selected time range: sum(missed) / (sum(served) + sum(missed)).

panels.title: Delayed >tol %
panels.description: Fleet-wide share of attestations included more than 3 spec-slots late (shifted distance > 2): sum(delayed_over_tol) / (sum(served) + sum(missed)).

panels.title: Delayed %
panels.description: Fleet-wide share of attestations included 2+ slots later than optimal (spec distance ≥ 3): (sum(canonical_count) − sum(bucket{le=1.0})) / (sum(served) + sum(missed)).

panels.title: Attestation deficit (fleet)
panels.description: Fleet-wide attestation deficit over time. 0% = optimal; spikes indicate trouble. Tier 1 (red) = missed, Tier 2 (orange) = delayed beyond tolerance.

panels.title: Validator Clusters — top 50 by issue score
panels.description: Per-cluster rollup over the dashboard time range, ranked by issue score = missed + 0.5*delayed_over_tolerance + 0.1*any_delay. Only clusters with a non-zero issue score are shown (top 50 by score). Click a Cluster cell to filter the rest of the dashboard to that cluster. Success % = Served / (Served + Missed). Delayed = count of canonical attestations included 2+ slots later than optimal (spec distance ≥ 3, computed from the canonical-distance histogram as count − bucket{le=1.0}); Delayed >tol uses the stricter threshold (spec distance > 3). The three rate columns are each count / (Served + Missed).

targets.expr: topk(50, sum by (container) (increase(ETH2_totalMissedAttestations{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range])) + 0.5 * sum by (container) (increase(ETH2_totalDelayedAttestationsOverTolerance{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range])) + 0.1 * (sum by (container) (increase(ETH2_canonicalAttestationDistances_count{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container"}[$__range])) - sum by (container) (increase(ETH2_canonicalAttestationDistances_bucket{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",le="1.0"}[$__range])))) > 0

panels.title: Validators — top $top by issue score
panels.description: Per-validator snapshot over the dashboard time range, ranked by issue score = missed + 0.5*delayed_over_tolerance. Only validators with a non-zero issue score are shown (top-$top by score). Click an Index to filter the dashboard to this validator; click a Pubkey to open beaconcha.in.

targets.expr: sum by (validator_index, pubkey, container) (increase(ETH2_totalMissedAttestations{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range])) and on(validator_index, pubkey, container) (topk($top, sum by (validator_index, pubkey, container) (increase(ETH2_totalMissedAttestations{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range]) + 0.5 * increase(ETH2_totalDelayedAttestationsOverTolerance{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range]))) > 0)

sum by (validator_index, pubkey, container) (increase(ETH2_totalServedAttestations{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range])) and on(validator_index, pubkey, container) (topk($top, sum by (validator_index, pubkey, container) (increase(ETH2_totalMissedAttestations{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range]) + 0.5 * increase(ETH2_totalDelayedAttestationsOverTolerance{service=~"$service",container!="",container=~"$container",validator_index!=""}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: % missed (per cluster, 15m)
panels.description: Per-cluster attestation miss rate over the last 15 minutes. One line per scrape cluster. Severity bands: <0.5% green, 0.5–2% yellow, >2% red.

panels.title: % delayed-over-tolerance (per cluster, 15m)
panels.description: Per-cluster share of attestations delayed beyond the spec-distance tolerance over the last 15 minutes. One line per scrape cluster. Severity bands: <0.5% green, 0.5–2% yellow, >2% red.

panels.title: Canonical Distance Distribution (missed-slot-adjusted)
panels.description: Snapshot distribution of canonical inclusion distances over the dashboard time range. X = shifted slots (0 = optimal, included at attestedSlot+1). Y = sample count. Histogram panel rendering of the de-cumulated bucket frame; each bar = count of attestations with that shifted distance.

panels.title: Raw Distance Distribution
panels.description: Snapshot distribution of raw inclusion distances over the dashboard time range (before missed-slot adjustment). X = shifted slots (0 = optimal, included at attestedSlot+1). Y = sample count. Histogram panel rendering of the de-cumulated bucket frame; each bar = count of attestations with that shifted distance.

panels.title: Missed Slots In Epoch
panels.description: Missed slots in the most recently processed epoch, per cluster. ≥3 = network stress signal (chain-wide). If only one cluster shows this, more likely a monitor stall.

panels.title: Cross-Epoch Attestations (rate)
panels.description: Attestations that were included in a later epoch than the one they attested to. A sustained non-zero rate usually means stale validator-client chain state — the validator missed the slot transition before signing.

panels.title: Empty / Vanilla / Missing-bid Proposals
panels.description: Three MEV-related counters: empty blocks (no EL value), vanilla blocks (proposer didn't use a relay bid), and missing-bid-traces (no tracked relay returned any bid).

panels.title: Request Rate by Endpoint
panels.description: Stacked beacon-API request rate by endpoint ($__rate_interval; auto-sized to viewport). $__rate_interval is used so rate() doesn't underreport during cold-start uptime over a long fixed window (which produces a misleading upward ramp).

panels.title: Error Rate by Endpoint + status_class
panels.description: Beacon-API non-2xx response rate by endpoint and status class (5m).

panels.title: Request Duration p50 by Endpoint
panels.description: Beacon-API request latency p50 by endpoint (10m).

panels.title: Request Duration p99 by Endpoint
panels.description: Beacon-API request latency p99 by endpoint (10m).

panels.title: Attestation served rate (15m)
panels.description: Fleet-wide rate of canonical attestations being recorded by the monitor, smoothed over a 15-minute trailing window. Pairs with the Attestation deficit panel: this shows healthy throughput, that shows failures. A sudden drop indicates validators going offline or the monitor falling behind.

panels.title: Attestation served rate (per cluster, 15m)
panels.description: Per-cluster rate of canonical attestations recorded over a 15-minute trailing window. One line per cluster — the healthy baseline view paired with the per-cluster miss / delayed-over-tolerance panels to the right.

list.description: Which eth2-monitor instance to read from. Usually one (alias: Job).

list.description: A logical group of validators deployed together. Pick one to scope the rest of the dashboard, or *All*.
list.label: Cluster

list.description: Drill to one validator index. Usually *All* except during incident response.
list.label: Validator

list.description: How many rows to show in topk rankings (tables and per-validator timeseries).
